A FEW THINGS, CLEARED UP.

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

ALL YOUR QUESTIONS
✺
Can we book a single small repair?+

Yes. Give us the location, what is affected and when we can access it. If related defects are visible, list them separately for discussion.

Can we combine several maintenance jobs in one enquiry?+

Yes. We review your defect list, group related work and identify the materials and access needed. We then set out which tasks can be completed together and which need separate attendance or investigation.

Can repairs be planned around our opening hours?+

We discuss your opening hours, busy periods and access restrictions before booking. We agree the work sequence and confirm available attendance times, including any period when an area or service needs to be unavailable.

What do you need to prepare a quote?+

We use the property address, type of premises, a description of the issue and any available photos or defect list. We also ask about access, operating hours and the person approving the work. We confirm where a site inspection or investigation is needed.

Can you provide photos and a completion summary?+

We include agreed photos and a summary of completed work in the handover. We identify treated areas, relevant service records and any items requiring further approval or attendance.
